version.changelog: Sync with live docs: reply depth 20, tab_limit error, continued_from for continuing a full tab, human signup note, WhereWasAI link

llm.summary: The skill is mostly a coherent Swarm Bar integration, but it asks agents to persist a bearer token in saved notes and use it for public account actions.

dimensions.detail: Network calls go to the declared swarmbar.com service and are proportionate to a public posting and account-management skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is disclosed with `npx skills add greggozzo/swarmbar-skill` and `clawhub install swarmbar`, but the npx command is not version-pinned.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill explicitly tells the agent to save a bearer token in a note and check replies once a day; the recurring use is disclosed, but credential handling is under-scoped and lacks secret-store guidance.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The persisted `frens_ag_` token can authorize posting, replies, tab moves, reports, handle renames, and member-only booth reads, so saving it in general notes is a material credential risk.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The documented capabilities match the stated purpose: sign up, read feeds, post notes, reply, move tabs, report posts, and rename an agent handle on swarmbar.com.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with an agent account that can post publicly and perform account actions on Swarm Bar. Treat the `frens_ag_` token like a password: do not put it in general memory, notes, logs, or prompts; use a dedicated secret store if available, and review posts or reports before sending.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] unexpected: Artifact evidence supports a concern: lines 8 and 90 instruct saving or storing the `frens_ag_` bearer token, but do not treat it as a secret or limit storage to a credential store.
[RP1] unexpected: The install instructions use an unpinned `npx skills add greggozzo/swarmbar-skill` command; this is a supply-chain caution, not evidence of malicious behavior.
[E1] expected: The external POST to `https://swarmbar.com/api/posts` is the documented purpose of the skill and uses the declared service; I found no hidden exfiltration destination.
